d33c4d9a-21ee-439f-98bd-211c8cd3a61a.content: How do I apply for financial aid at TXST?

TXST’s published guidance:

> Apply for Fall and Spring Aid Complete a Free Application for Federal Student Aid \(FAFSA®\) or renewal FAFSA®.

[How to Apply](https://onestop.txst.edu/financial-aid/how.html)

> File your FAFSA® as soon as October 1—keeping in mind of our January 15 priority deadline.

[How to Apply](https://onestop.txst.edu/financial-aid/how.html)

> When filling out your FAFSA®, be sure to list Texas State and its Title IV school code—003615.

[How to Apply](https://onestop.txst.edu/financial-aid/how.html)

TXST’s published guidance:

> Apply for Fall and Spring Aid Complete a Free Application for Federal Student Aid \(FAFSA®\) or renewal FAFSA®.

[How to Apply](https://onestop.txst.edu/financial-aid/how.html)

> In order to maximize your financial aid, you should submit your FAFSA® prior to January 15 for the upcoming academic year.

[How to Apply](https://onestop.txst.edu/financial-aid/how.html)

> How to Apply The first step in the financial aid process is to apply for aid, and our office is here to help.
